

::: {#def-intervention-ffrcistg .theorem}
## Intervention FFRCISTG

An *intervention FFRCISTG* is the member of an [FFRCISTG model](#def-ffrcistg) corresponding to a specific [intervention](#def-intervention) \(a\). It is an [NPSEM-IE](#def-npsem-ie) whose structural equations are modified by \(a\), that shares the same exogenous error terms as the observed model, and that—within the FFRCISTG collection—satisfies *no spillover* ([No spillover](#def-no-spillover)), *no interference* ([No interference](#def-no-interference)), and *identical distributions* ([Identical distributions](#def-identical-distributions)).

$$
\mathcal{C}=\{\mathscr M^{(a)}:a\in\mathcal A\}, 
\qquad
\mathscr M=\{f_V,\,U_V:V\in\mathbf V\}
$$

For a fixed intervention \(a\), the intervention FFRCISTG is
$$
\mathscr M^{(a)}=\{f_V^{(a)},\,U_V:V\in\mathbf V\},
\qquad
V = f_V^{(a)}\!\big(\mathbf{Pa}^{(a)}(V),\,U_V\big),\ \ V\in\mathbf V,
$$
with \(\{U_V:V\in\mathbf V\}\) mutually independent and having the same joint law in \(\mathscr M^{(a)}\) as in \(\mathscr M^{(\emptyset)}\).

For a *node intervention* that fixes \(A\subseteq\mathbf V\) at \(a\):
$$
f_A^{(a)}(\,\cdot\,,U_A)\equiv a,
\qquad
\mathbf{Pa}^{(a)}(A)=\varnothing,
\qquad
f_V^{(a)}=f_V,\ \mathbf{Pa}^{(a)}(V)=\mathbf{Pa}(V)\ \text{for }V\notin A.
$$

(Analogously, *edge* or more general interventions replace designated arguments of the relevant \(f_V\) by constants or alternative functions.)

Each member satisfies the FFRCISTG assumptions:
$$
\forall a\in\mathcal A:\quad
\mathscr M^{(a)}\ \text{satisfies}\ 
\text{NoSpill}\ \wedge\ \text{NoInterf}\ \wedge\ \text{IdentDist}.
$$

The counterfactual vector \(\big(V^{(a)}:V\in\mathbf V\big)\) is defined by recursive substitution within \(\mathscr M^{(a)}\).
:::
